name: qwen3_8b_niah_v2_owncalib
description: Qwen3-8B NIAH sweep, calibration-unified: int2 and vq2 re-served on rotations recomputed from OUR 198-prompt GPQA corpus (v1 used the authors' released rotations, 83 prompts / their capture — kept as the 'production OSCAR as released' record). K codebook (gpqacc64k) already derives from the same corpus and is unchanged.

calibration.k_codebook_recipe: Samuel's gpqacc64k train (same 198-prompt corpus, 8x64K cycled, ptn/stratified/flat/2bpc); rotation-independent

reused_methods.int2_authors_rotation: artifacts/oscar_e2e/int2 + lh (v1 record — production OSCAR as released)

protocol.niah: greedy (T=0), 1 rollout/row, gen cap 128, accuracy = mean RULER string_match over 8 subtasks
protocol.serving: token pool 140000/GPU, CUDA graphs, MAX_REQS=24; mixed-KV band 64 sink + 256 recent bf16
